cases.name: diagnoses AIE2P workers placed off compute tiles

stdin.text:
aie2p.target<array> @array_target {device_profile = "amd.xdna.strix_halo.17f0_11"}

aie2p.target<core> @core_target

low.func.def public retain target<amd.xdna.aie2p.array>(@array_target) abi(array_program) @noncompute_worker_array() asm {
  %zero = constant.u32 0 : reg<aie2p.array.scalar : index>
  %one = constant.u32 1 : reg<aie2p.array.scalar : index>
  %capacity = constant.u32 2 : reg<aie2p.array.scalar : index>
  %group = group %one
  %worker = worker %group, %zero, @consume_worker
  %input = binding 0, "read"
  %sender = sender %input, 0 : reg<aie2p.array.sender : tile<1xi32>>
  %receiver = receiver %worker, 0 : reg<aie2p.array.receiver : tile<1xi32>>
  %channel = channel %sender, %receiver, %capacity, %one : reg<aie2p.array.channel : tile<1xi32>>
  constrain.location %worker, %zero, %zero
  return
}

low.func.def target<amd.xdna.aie2p.core>(@core_target) abi(object_function) @consume_worker() asm {
  %input = resource<native_pointer> {index = 0, source_type = buffer} : reg<aie2p.ep>
  return
}

contains: AIE2P worker 0 cannot occupy tile (0, 0): the coordinate is not a compute tile
